notes: Converted from NRT's embedded zone map (simplified shapes); re-check after Niagara Region's new website launches. The map data stores coordinates as [lat, lng]; they were swapped to [lon, lat]. Fort Erie is three separate parts in the map and is kept as one MultiPolygon. Thorold is marked inactive in the map with no outline and is left out. The map data also lists one-way travel pairs between some zones (not written as rules): Riverview South to Riverview North; Port Weller and Lakeshore to STC North; STC West 1 to STC West 2. The 12 transit hub access points come from the same map data; each stop's areaName lists every zone the map says it serves.
